name: Purella SOFTWA
summary: Water Conditioner Purella SoftWa brings a happy and healthy lifestyle to you. It helps in protecting your appliances like Washing Machine, Dishwasher and Geyser from lime scale with its dual filtration process.
intro: Purella SoftWa brings happy and healthy lifestyle to you. It helps in protecting your appliances like Washing machine, Dishwasher and Geyser. Purella SoftWa has dual filtration process. Mesh-Filter helps in removing visible impurities and Heavy dust Particles and Polyphosphate Silicate Sphere Remove Lime-scale and Conditions Water. A blend of conscious design, proven technology and versatility was envisioned while creation of Purella SoftWa. Made in India, Purella SoftWa is developed in such a way that it fits directly on tap and on the appliances too, this feature helps to avoid dead space created by such filters if fitted behind appliance.
features: Washing Machine: Protects from lime scales and extends its life. Improves washing by reducing lime scale on clothes. Preserves clothes colour and natural softness.
Geyser: Protects from Lime Scale and extends its life. Gives Conditioned/Polished water (Lime-scale Free).
Dishwasher: Protects from lime scales and extends its life. Does not leave stains of lime scale on utensils. Maintains shine of stainless-steel utensils.
Mesh Filter: Removes visible impurities and Heavy Dust Particles.
Polyphosphate Silicate Spheres: Remove Lime-scale and Condition Water.
